Marcus is an account manager on the North team, so a mail to him with the rate needs Anselm's or June's approval first, even as a draft. It doesn't matter that the rate came from you as the owner.

I've messaged June asking for approval and logged the request. Once she says yes, I'll save the draft to Marcus (mlindqvist@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate" and the $1,752 per-seat figure, and you can send it yourself. If you'd rather ask Anselm, or ping June directly, either works.
